g.text: Up is not the same as working — what HEALTHCHECK adds
A health check only reports. To act on it you need restart: unless-stopped (the container is restarted when its process EXITS)
or depends_on: condition: service_healthy so a second service refuses to start until this one is genuinely ready.
Exited (137) + OOMKilled=true -> it did not crash, the memory limit killed it.
